# Spice Garden

> Modern Indian fine-dining restaurant in Alkapuri, Vadodara — dine-in reservations, live queue, and QR table ordering.

## Pages
- [Home](https://spice-garden-tau.vercel.app/): Overview, ambience, and reservations
- [Menu](https://spice-garden-tau.vercel.app/menu): Full menu with INR pricing
- [Reservation](https://spice-garden-tau.vercel.app/reservation): Book a table
- [Track Order](https://spice-garden-tau.vercel.app/order-status): Live order status
- [Gallery](https://spice-garden-tau.vercel.app/gallery): Photos of the space and dishes
- [Contact](https://spice-garden-tau.vercel.app/contact): Location and contact details

## Notes
- All prices in INR. Location: Vadodara, Gujarat, India.
